title_tag: 中国人，到底要不要学英语？中国现在那么牛，为啥还要学英语？—— 经济学人外刊讲解第1171天
h1: 中国人，到底要不要学英语？中国现在那么牛，为啥还要学英语？
category: 经济学人外刊讲解 第1171天
nav_hint: Is this the end for English in China?

headline.en_html: Is this the end for China's love of the English language?
headline.zh: 中国人对英语的热爱，就此终结了吗？

paragraphs.en_html: Half a century ago, learning English went almost <mark class="voc">overnight</mark> from being discouraged to a national obsession. Throughout the 1980s and beyond, young and old <mark class="voc">alike</mark> would gather in parks, at what became known as “English corners”, to practise with each other. The language became a <mark class="voc">core</mark> part of the national <mark class="voc">curriculum</mark>, <mark class="voc">on a par with</mark> maths and Chinese, <mark class="voc">right up to</mark> the gaokao, or university entrance exam.
paragraphs.zh: 半个世纪前，学英语几乎在一夜之间，从一件受冷落的事变成了一种举国上下的痴迷。整个二十世纪八十年代乃至其后，男女老少齐聚公园，在后来被称为“英语角”的地方彼此练习。英语成为国家课程的核心部分，与数学、语文并驾齐驱，一路贯穿至高考。

notes.en: suddenly and unexpectedly; in a very short period of time
notes.ctx: 指学英语从被冷落到举国痴迷的转变来得极快，几乎不需要过渡期。
notes.ex1: The small startup became a household name overnight after its app went viral. 那家初创公司在其应用走红后一夜之间家喻户晓。
notes.ex2: You can't expect to master a new language overnight; it takes years of consistent practice. 你不能指望一夜之间掌握一门新语言，那需要多年持之以恒的练习。

notes.en: in the same way; equally
notes.ctx: young and old alike 指男女老少不分年龄，都涌向公园练口语。
notes.ex1: The new policy affects small and large businesses alike. 新政策对大小企业一视同仁。
notes.ex2: The teacher treats all her students alike, regardless of their backgrounds. 这位老师对所有学生一视同仁，不论其背景如何。

notes.en: central; most important or fundamental
notes.ctx: core part 指英语在国家课程里处于最核心、不可替代的位置。
notes.ex1: Critical thinking is a core skill that every university graduate should possess. 批判性思维是每位大学毕业生都应具备的核心技能。
notes.ex2: The company's core values have remained unchanged for over three decades. 这家公司的核心价值观三十多年来始终未变。

notes.en: the subjects comprising a course of study in a school or college
notes.ctx: national curriculum 指全国统一规定的课程体系，英语被直接写进其中。
notes.ex1: The school has revised its curriculum to include more practical coding classes. 该校修订了课程体系，加入了更多实用的编程课。
notes.ex2: Environmental education should be integrated into the curriculum at every grade level. 环境教育应融入各个年级的课程之中。

notes.en: equal to; of the same importance or standard
notes.zh: 与……不相上下，与……同等重要
notes.ctx: 指英语被放在与数学、语文完全同一档的位置上。
notes.ex1: Her latest novel is on a par with the best literary works of our time. 她的新小说不亚于当代最优秀的文学作品。
notes.ex2: In this company, customer service is on a par with product innovation in terms of strategic priority. 在这家公司，客户服务与产品创新在战略优先级上同等重要。

notes.en: all the way until; extending as far as
notes.ctx: 指英语的核心地位一路延续到高考，整个基础教育阶段从未中断。
notes.ex1: The museum is open every day right up to the end of December. 博物馆每天开放，一直到十二月底。
notes.ex2: She worked on the project right up to the moment she gave birth. 她一直工作到分娩那一刻。

paragraphs.en_html: Now a <mark class="voc">prominent</mark> teacher and education blogger has <mark class="voc">reignited</mark> a national debate by questioning whether learning English is necessary at all. “Our children <mark class="voc">desperately</mark> begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language,” Tang Jiafeng wrote. “Yet we are a <mark class="voc">civilisation</mark> that <mark class="voc">dates back</mark> thousands of years. English is just a tool. It’s enough to be able to use it.”
paragraphs.zh: 如今，一位知名教师兼教育博主再度点燃了一场全国性辩论——他质疑学英语到底有没有必要。“我们的孩子连母语都还没真正掌握，就拼命开始学英语，”汤家凤写道，“可我们是拥有数千年历史的文明。英语不过是个工具，会用就够了。”

notes.en: important, famous, or easily noticed
notes.ctx: a prominent teacher 指在公众视野里知名度高、说话有分量的老师。
notes.ex1: She is a prominent figure in the field of artificial intelligence research. 她是人工智能研究领域的知名人物。
notes.ex2: The prominent clock tower can be seen from every corner of the town. 那座显眼的钟楼从镇上的每个角落都能看到。

notes.en: to start again or make something start again; to revive
notes.ctx: 指这场“要不要学英语”的争论本来已存在，被他一番话重新点着。
notes.ex1: The controversial film reignited the debate about freedom of speech. 这部争议影片重新点燃了关于言论自由的辩论。
notes.ex2: His speech reignited her passion for environmental activism. 他的演讲重新点燃了她对环保运动的热情。

notes.en: in a way that shows extreme urgency or a strong need
notes.ctx: 形容孩子带着近乎绝望的劲头去学英语，暗含对这种过度的批评。
notes.ex1: He desperately wanted to finish the marathon despite his injury. 尽管受伤，他还是拼命想跑完马拉松。
notes.ex2: The refugees desperately needed food and medical supplies. 难民们迫切需要食物和医疗物资。

notes.en: a society with its own culture, history, and way of life
notes.ctx: 指中国是有着数千年积淀的文明，用来自证不必这么急着学外语。
notes.ex1: Ancient Egyptian civilisation flourished along the banks of the Nile for thousands of years. 古埃及文明在尼罗河沿岸繁荣了数千年。
notes.ex2: The invention of writing marked a turning point in human civilisation. 文字的发明标志着人类文明的一个转折点。

notes.en: to have existed since a particular time in the past
notes.ctx: 指中华文明的历史可以上溯数千年，强调的是时间纵深。
notes.ex1: This temple dates back to the Tang Dynasty. 这座寺庙可追溯到唐代。
notes.ex2: Their family's tradition of making handmade noodles dates back over two hundred years. 他们家制作手工面条的传统可追溯至两百多年前。

paragraphs.en_html: The debate touches on questions of whether children are over-pressured by schools and parents and the <mark class="voc">suitability</mark> of traditional <mark class="voc">rote-learning</mark> techniques. It has also acquired a new <mark class="voc">dimension</mark> as artificial-intelligence translation tools improve. With technology increasingly capable of translating languages almost instantly, some young people are asking whether years of intensive English study will remain as valuable as it once was. At the same time, uncertainty about graduate employment has <mark class="voc">prompted</mark> a wider discussion about which skills students will actually need when they enter the <mark class="voc">workforce</mark>.
paragraphs.zh: 这场辩论触及了诸多问题：孩子是否被学校和家长施压过重，传统死记硬背式教学法是否合宜。随着人工智能翻译工具日益精进，辩论又多了一个新维度。当技术越来越能近乎即时地翻译语言，一些年轻人开始发问：多年苦学英语，是否还会像从前那样值钱？与此同时，毕业生就业前景的不确定性，也引发了更广泛的讨论——学生步入职场后，究竟需要哪些技能？

notes.en: the quality of being right or appropriate for a particular purpose
notes.ctx: 指传统死记硬背那套方法到底还合不合适、是否匹配今天的教育需求。
notes.ex1: Parents often question the suitability of screen-based learning for young children. 家长常常质疑屏幕学习对幼儿的适宜性。
notes.ex2: The committee assessed the suitability of the candidate for the leadership role. 委员会评估了该候选人担任领导职务的合适程度。

notes.en: learning by repetition and memory without necessarily understanding
notes.ctx: 指以反复背诵、机械记忆为主、不重理解的教学方式，是这场争论的焦点之一。
notes.ex1: Rote-learning may help students pass exams, but it rarely fosters deep understanding. 死记硬背或许能帮学生通过考试，却很难培养深度理解。
notes.ex2: Many educators argue that rote-learning stifles creativity in young learners. 许多教育工作者认为死记硬背会扼杀年幼学习者的创造力。

notes.en: an aspect or feature of a situation
notes.ctx: 指 AI 翻译的进步给这场辩论添了一个此前没有的观察角度。
notes.ex1: The discovery added a new dimension to our understanding of the universe. 这一发现为我们理解宇宙增添了新的维度。
notes.ex2: The debate has a moral dimension that cannot be ignored. 这场辩论有一个不容忽视的道德层面。

notes.en: to cause or encourage something to happen
notes.ctx: 指就业前景不明朗这一点，成了那场更广泛讨论的导火索。
notes.ex1: The rising cost of living prompted many families to cut back on non-essential spending. 生活成本上涨促使许多家庭削减非必要开支。
notes.ex2: Her question prompted a lively discussion among the panel members. 她的提问引发了嘉宾之间的热烈讨论。

notes.en: the people who work for a company or country, considered as a group
notes.ctx: enter the workforce 指学生毕业进入职场，成为劳动人口的一部分。
notes.ex1: The company plans to expand its workforce by hiring 500 new employees. 公司计划通过招聘500名新员工来扩大劳动力。
notes.ex2: As more women enter the workforce, childcare services have become increasingly important. 随着更多女性进入职场，托儿服务变得越来越重要。

paragraphs.en_html: Tang, who has a PhD in mathematics and offers <mark class="voc">tuition</mark> for <mark class="voc">postgraduate</mark> entrance exams, has <mark class="voc">established himself as</mark> a popular voice in the competitive world of online advice for students. His most recent post was a reaction to announcements by <mark class="voc">provincial</mark> education authorities that they were <mark class="voc">downgrading</mark> <mark class="voc">noncore</mark> subjects like biology, geography and history for high-school entrance exams to reduce the pressure on teenagers. Liaoning province, for example, recently removed history, biology and geography from its middle-school entry test as part of efforts to reduce students’ <mark class="voc">workload</mark>.
paragraphs.zh: 汤家凤拥有数学博士学位，从事考研辅导，在竞争激烈的线上升学咨询领域已确立起颇受欢迎的声音。他最近这篇发文，是对多省教育部门宣布下调生物、地理、历史等非核心科目在中考中权重的回应——此举意在减轻青少年压力。例如，辽宁省最近将历史、生物、地理移出中考，作为减负努力的一部分。

notes.en: teaching or instruction, especially for a small group or individual; also the fee for this
notes.ctx: offers tuition 指他靠课外辅导吃饭，这里是“辅导”而不是“学费”。
notes.ex1: He earns extra money by giving private tuition in mathematics. 他通过私下辅导数学来赚外快。
notes.ex2: The tuition for this language course includes all learning materials. 这门语言课程的辅导费用包含所有学习材料。

notes.en: a student who has already obtained a first degree and is studying for a higher one
notes.ctx: postgraduate entrance exams 指研究生入学考试，也就是中国俗称的“考研”。
notes.ex1: She decided to pursue postgraduate studies in economics at a top university. 她决定在一所顶尖大学攻读经济学研究生。
notes.ex2: Postgraduate students often face pressure to publish their research. 研究生常常面临发表研究成果的压力。

notes.en: to make something or someone be recognized or accepted as something
notes.ctx: 指他在竞争激烈的升学说号里挣得了“颇受欢迎的声音”这一身份。
notes.ex1: The company has established itself as a leader in renewable energy technology. 该公司已确立自身在可再生能源技术领域的领先地位。
notes.ex2: Her debut novel established her as one of the most promising young writers of her generation. 她的处女作使她成为同代人中最有前途的年轻作家之一。

notes.en: relating to a province or the provinces of a country
notes.ctx: provincial education authorities 指省一级的教育行政部门，是这次调整考试科目的政策主体。
notes.ex1: Provincial governments have been given more autonomy in economic decision-making. 省级政府在经济决策方面获得了更多自主权。
notes.ex2: The provincial museum houses a remarkable collection of ancient ceramics. 这家省级博物馆收藏了大量精美的古代陶瓷。

notes.en: to reduce the importance, status, or value of something
notes.ctx: 指把生物、地理、历史这些科目在中考里的分量往下压。
notes.ex1: An airline downgraded his ticket from business class to economy due to overbooking. 由于超售，航空公司将他的机票从商务舱降为经济舱。
notes.ex2: Analysts downgraded the stock after the company reported disappointing earnings. 在公司公布令人失望的财报后，分析师下调了该股票的评级。

notes.en: not belonging to the central or most important part of something
notes.ctx: 指不属于语数外那类核心科目的学科，比如生物、地理、历史。
notes.ex1: The company decided to sell off its noncore assets to focus on its main business. 公司决定出售非核心资产以专注于主营业务。
notes.ex2: Noncore courses are often the first to be cut when school budgets shrink. 当学校预算缩减时，非核心课程往往最先被削减。

notes.en: the amount of work that a person or organization has to do
notes.ctx: reduce students’ workload 指给学生减负，压缩的是课业总量。
notes.ex1: Teachers are complaining about an excessive workload and insufficient pay. 教师们抱怨工作量过大而薪酬不足。
notes.ex2: The new software is designed to help doctors manage their daily workload more efficiently. 这款新软件旨在帮助医生更高效地管理日常工作量。

paragraphs.en_html: Tang claimed that this was <mark class="voc">effectively</mark> <mark class="voc">prioritising</mark> a subject, English, that would be “completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives”. English remains a compulsory subject in China’s basic education system alongside Chinese and mathematics. Under the traditional 750-point gaokao structure, each of those three subjects is worth 150 points, even as the weighting and assessment of other subjects have <mark class="voc">undergone</mark> reforms.
paragraphs.zh: 汤家凤称，这实际上是在优先照顾一门对“大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关”的科目——英语。在中国基础教育体系中，英语仍与语文、数学并列为必修科目。在传统的高考750分结构中，这三门各占150分，即便其他科目的权重与考核方式已历经改革。

notes.en: in practice; in effect, even if not officially stated
notes.ctx: 指名义上在减负，实际效果却等于把英语摆到了更优先的位置。
notes.ex1: By raising taxes, the government effectively reduced people's disposable income. 通过加税，政府实际上减少了人们的可支配收入。
notes.ex2: The new regulation effectively bans smoking in all public spaces. 新规实际上禁止了在所有公共场所吸烟。

notes.en: to treat something as more important than other things
notes.ctx: 指在科目排序上把英语往前挪，暗示资源与重视程度并不对等。
notes.ex1: The government should prioritise education over military spending. 政府应优先考虑教育而非军费开支。
notes.ex2: When time is limited, you must learn to prioritise the most urgent tasks. 时间有限时，你必须学会优先处理最紧急的任务。

notes.en: to experience or be subjected to something
notes.ctx: 指其他科目的权重和考核方式已经历过多轮改动。
notes.ex1: The city has undergone dramatic changes over the past decade. 过去十年间，这座城市经历了翻天覆地的变化。
notes.ex2: Patients who undergo this surgery usually recover within two weeks. 接受这种手术的病人通常在两周内康复。
